title: Lotte Mart E-commerce Platform
tagline: Full-stack B2B/B2C e-commerce dengan AI CS system, real-time delivery tracking & WhatsApp automation.
problem: Platform e-commerce Lotte Mart butuh upgrade menyeluruh — dari Flutter Web ke Next.js, integrasi payment gateway DOKU/Espay, real-time delivery via GrabExpress API, dan WhatsApp notifications. Ditambah tim CS kewalahan handle repetitive queries, butuh AI assistant yang ngerti konteks order.
challenges: Migrasi Flutter Web → Next.js App Router dengan zero downtime, Core Web Vitals & SEO improvements terukur
Arsitektur AI CS system LOVA (LangGraph + GPT-4o-mini + WebSocket) — optimasi dari ~30K ke ~5K token/session (83% reduction)
Payment & delivery pipeline: DOKU/Espay webhook handlers + GrabExpress real-time tracking untuk 20–50 stores
tagline_en: Full-stack B2B/B2C e-commerce with AI CS system, real-time delivery tracking & WhatsApp automation.
problem_en: Lotte Mart's e-commerce platform needed a full overhaul — migrating from Flutter Web to Next.js, integrating DOKU/Espay payment gateways, real-time delivery via GrabExpress API, and WhatsApp notifications. Plus, the CS team was overwhelmed by repetitive queries and needed an AI assistant that understood order context.
challenges_en: Migrating Flutter Web → Next.js App Router with zero downtime, measurable Core Web Vitals & SEO improvements
Architecting LOVA AI CS system (LangGraph + GPT-4o-mini + WebSocket) — optimized from ~30K to ~5K tokens/session (83% reduction)
Payment & delivery pipeline: DOKU/Espay webhook handlers + GrabExpress real-time tracking across 20–50 stores

title: RML Store — Digital Goods Platform
tagline: B2C SaaS platform untuk top-up games, e-wallets & vouchers — 3-service architecture on self-managed VPS.
problem: Butuh platform digital goods yang scalable, bisa handle ribuan SKU dari multiple suppliers, dengan automated catalog ingestion dan proper cashback/voucher lifecycle — semua dijalankan sendiri di VPS tanpa tim.
challenges: 3-service architecture: rml-web (Next.js), rml-core (Fastify v5 + worker), rml-admin — deployed di Contabo VPS dengan Nginx reverse proxy + SSL/Certbot
Lapakgaming supplier API integration: 4-step import modal, Auto Best Supplier toggling, per-variant pricing management
Nginx config: security headers, rate limiting, forced IPv4 DNS resolution to bypass Cloudflare blocking supplier APIs

outcomes.s: Google OAuth via Supabase + admin service-role

tagline_en: B2C SaaS platform for game top-ups, e-wallets & vouchers — 3-service architecture on a self-managed VPS.
problem_en: Needed a scalable digital goods platform that handles thousands of SKUs from multiple suppliers with automated catalog ingestion and a proper cashback/voucher lifecycle — all operated solo on a VPS.
challenges_en: 3-service architecture: rml-web (Next.js), rml-core (Fastify v5 + worker), rml-admin — deployed on Contabo VPS with Nginx reverse proxy + SSL/Certbot
Lapakgaming supplier API integration: 4-step import modal, Auto Best Supplier toggling, per-variant pricing management
Nginx config: security headers, rate limiting, forced IPv4 DNS resolution to bypass Cloudflare blocking of supplier APIs

title: Lotte Mart Point App
tagline: Mobile loyalty app untuk point redemption, e-vouchers & promotions — 100K+ users di Play Store & App Store.
problem: Lotte Mart butuh loyalty app yang bisa handle point redemption, e-vouchers, dan promotions untuk ratusan ribu member di seluruh cabang Indonesia — tersedia di Android & iOS dengan pengalaman yang smooth.
challenges: Cross-platform development Flutter + Kotlin Native untuk fitur platform-spesifik (push notifications, barcode scanner)
Skalabilitas: handle 100K+ registered users dengan high-availability backend dan real-time point calculation
OneSignal integration untuk targeted push notifications berdasarkan tier member dan lokasi cabang
tagline_en: Mobile loyalty app for point redemption, e-vouchers & promotions — 100K+ users on Play Store & App Store.
problem_en: Lotte Mart needed a loyalty app to handle point redemption, e-vouchers, and promotions for hundreds of thousands of members across all Indonesian branches — available on both Android & iOS.
challenges_en: Cross-platform development with Flutter + Kotlin Native for platform-specific features (push notifications, barcode scanner)
Scalability: handling 100K+ registered users with a high-availability backend and real-time point calculation
OneSignal integration for targeted push notifications based on member tier and branch location

title: Floree — Florist Platform
tagline: Website penjualan bunga florist dengan storefront + CMS Dashboard — full Next.js stack.
problem: Platform penjualan bunga florist yang butuh dua sisi: storefront yang cantik dan fast untuk customer browsing & order bunga, plus CMS Dashboard untuk florist manage produk, kategori, order, dan konten — semua dalam satu ekosistem Next.js.
challenges: Desain storefront yang visually appealing sesuai aesthetic florist — responsive di semua device dengan image-heavy catalog
CMS Dashboard yang intuitif untuk florist yang tidak technical — manage produk, variants, upload foto, kelola order
Arsitektur monorepo atau multi-app Next.js: floree-frontend (storefront) + floree-cms (dashboard) dengan shared types
tagline_en: Florist sales website with a customer storefront + CMS Dashboard — full Next.js stack.
problem_en: A florist platform needs two sides: a beautiful, fast storefront for customers to browse & order flowers, plus a CMS Dashboard for the florist to manage products, categories, orders, and content — all within a single Next.js ecosystem.
challenges_en: Visually appealing storefront matching the florist aesthetic — responsive on all devices with an image-heavy catalog
Intuitive CMS Dashboard for non-technical florists — manage products, variants, photo uploads, and orders
Multi-app Next.js architecture: floree-frontend (storefront) + floree-cms (dashboard) with shared types

title: Naomi — Cardiac Monitoring App
tagline: Remote patient monitoring system: Flutter mobile app + web dashboard untuk dokter spesialis jantung.
problem: Dokter spesialis jantung butuh sistem monitoring pasien jarak jauh — pasien bisa log vitals dari mobile app, dokter pantau dari web dashboard, dengan appointment tracking dan komunikasi dokter-pasien yang terintegrasi.
challenges: Real-time vitals sync antara Flutter mobile app dan Node.js web dashboard via WebSocket
Desain UX yang intuitif untuk pasien lansia — simple flow, large typography, minimal friction
Data integrity: vitals logging dengan timestamp akurat untuk keperluan rekam medis
tagline_en: Remote patient monitoring system: Flutter mobile app + web dashboard for a specialist cardiologist.
problem_en: A specialist cardiologist needed a remote patient monitoring system — patients log vitals from a mobile app, the doctor monitors from a web dashboard, with integrated appointment tracking and doctor-patient communication.
challenges_en: Real-time vitals sync between the Flutter mobile app and Node.js web dashboard via WebSocket
Intuitive UX design for elderly patients — simple flow, large typography, minimal friction
Data integrity: accurate timestamped vitals logging for medical record purposes

title: Jukir — Cashless Parking App
tagline: Aplikasi parkir cashless untuk Pemda Pekanbaru dengan e-payment, e-ticket & real-time collection reporting.
problem: Dinas Perhubungan Kota Pekanbaru butuh digitalisasi sistem parkir tepi jalan — dari cash manual ke cashless digital, dengan e-ticket, digital payments, dan real-time collection reporting untuk target Rp 20M/hari pendapatan parkir.
challenges: Integrasi multiple payment methods yang reliable di lapangan dengan koneksi internet yang tidak stabil
Real-time collection reporting untuk supervisor Dishub — live dashboard pendapatan per titik parkir
UX untuk juru parkir yang mayoritas tidak tech-savvy — training minimal, operasional langsung
tagline_en: Cashless parking app for Pekanbaru City Government with e-payment, e-ticket & real-time collection reporting.
problem_en: The Pekanbaru City Transportation Agency needed to digitize its roadside parking system — from manual cash collection to digital cashless, with e-tickets, digital payments, and real-time reporting targeting Rp 20M/day in parking revenue.
challenges_en: Reliable multi-method payment integration in the field with unstable internet connectivity
Real-time collection reporting for Dishub supervisors — live revenue dashboard per parking spot
UX for parking attendants who are mostly non-tech-savvy — minimal training, immediate operation

title: Fristrim — Film Streaming App
tagline: Consumer Android film streaming app built with Java Native — published di Google Play Store (discontinued ~2019).
problem: Ingin belajar end-to-end Android development dengan membangun produk nyata — dari native Java Android app sampai backend PHP, lalu publish ke Google Play Store. Film streaming app dipilih karena kompleksitasnya: media playback, catalog management, user auth, dan server infrastructure.
challenges: Native Java Android development — media player, adaptive streaming, background playback service
PHP CodeIgniter backend di CentOS 7 VPS — manage film catalog, user sessions, dan streaming endpoints
Google Play Store submission process — APK signing, store listing, content rating, policy compliance
tagline_en: Consumer Android film streaming app built with Java Native — published on Google Play Store (discontinued ~2019).
problem_en: Wanted to learn end-to-end Android development by building a real product — from native Java Android app to PHP backend, then publishing on the Google Play Store. A film streaming app was chosen for its complexity: media playback, catalog management, user auth, and server infrastructure.
challenges_en: Native Java Android development — media player, adaptive streaming, background playback service
PHP CodeIgniter backend on CentOS 7 VPS — managing film catalog, user sessions, and streaming endpoints
Google Play Store submission process — APK signing, store listing, content rating, policy compliance

title: PolyMarket BTC UP/DOWN Bot
tagline: Automated trading bot untuk Polymarket BTC 5-menit UP/DOWN markets — AI decision engine + Telegram monitoring, jalan 24/7.
problem: Polymarket punya market BTC UP/DOWN setiap 5 menit — window sempit, perlu decision cepat yang mempertimbangkan price momentum, orderbook imbalance, sentiment berita, dan liquidation data secara bersamaan. Mustahil dilakukan manual 24/7.
challenges: Multi-source data aggregation real-time: Binance WebSocket (tick data), CryptoPanic (news sentiment), Coinglass (liquidation + funding rate), Polymarket CLOB (orderbook + odds)
GPT-4o decision engine sebagai primary + rule-based fallback — output: { decision, confidence, reasoning } dengan confidence threshold sebelum eksekusi
5-menit cycle management: window detection dari Polymarket CLOB, signal processing dalam T+0:45s, eksekusi + monitoring via Telegram notification
tagline_en: Automated trading bot for Polymarket BTC 5-minute UP/DOWN markets — AI decision engine + Telegram monitoring, running 24/7.
problem_en: Polymarket runs BTC UP/DOWN markets every 5 minutes — tight windows requiring fast decisions that simultaneously consider price momentum, orderbook imbalance, news sentiment, and liquidation data. Impossible to do manually 24/7.
challenges_en: Real-time multi-source data aggregation: Binance WebSocket (tick data), CryptoPanic (news sentiment), Coinglass (liquidation + funding rate), Polymarket CLOB (orderbook + odds)
GPT-4o as primary decision engine + rule-based fallback — output: { decision, confidence, reasoning } with confidence threshold before execution
5-minute cycle management: window detection from Polymarket CLOB, signal processing within T+0:45s, execution + monitoring via Telegram notifications
